'''Co-Chancellor''' was a position of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]&ndash;the public face of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious&ndash;said to his [[Sith Master/Legends|master]] the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], he was intending to give him following the day of his [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|election]]. But it was not to be. The same night of Palpatine's election, Plagueis went intoxicated with [[Wine/Legends|wine]], allowing Sidious to kill him in order to make the [[Zabrak]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] and follow the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
